svg.title: The daemons: one list, two passes, one tree of Spring contexts
svg.desc: The Invoker registers each enabled service of etc/service-configuration.xml as a JMX MBean, calls init() on all of them in file order (pass 0), then start() on all of them (pass 1). Most daemons keep their beans in a Spring context.
svg.text: The daemons: one list, two passes, one tree of Spring contexts
The Invoker registers each enabled service of etc/service-configuration.xml as a JMX MBean, calls init() on all of them
in file order (pass 0), then start() on all of them (pass 1). Most daemons keep their beans in a Spring context.
Disabled in 33.1.8: Correlator, SnmpPoller, Tl1d, Syslogd,
AsteriskGateway. A service that throws in init() or start()

text.tspan: init(): builds the Jetty server from

svg.text: built-in copy. start(): starts Jetty, which deploys the web
apps, and the /opennms app starts Karaf (Steps 4 to 6).
start() checks every 5 s until Karaf's last boot feature has
registered its health service; after about 5 minutes
Spring contexts: a tree inside the JVM
A child context sees every bean of its parents: the web app
uses the daemons' DAOs and the same database pool.
